description: "My tickets": tickets of the connected GLPI user (or of users_id) where they are requester, assigned technician or observer. Defaults: open tickets only (not solved nor closed), most recently updated first. Each row names the people: requesters, assigned and observers as {id, name}, plus status_name and my_roles. Use this for "meus chamados", "my open tickets", "tickets assigned to me".

fields.description: Field set: 'essential' (default, trims internal GLPI fields) or 'all'

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default) or 'markdown' (a table for listings, key/value lines for one item; returned in both the text and the structured result)

order.description: Sort direction (default desc = most recent first)

role.description: Which link to the user: requester, assigned (technician), observer, or any (default)

status.description: Statuses to include (default open = not solved nor closed): new, assigned (= processing), planned, pending, solved, closed, open. One name or a list.

users_id.description: Another user's ID (default: the connected user)

name: glpi_list_my_tickets

format.description: 'markdown' when data holds the markdown rendering

note.description: Pagination hint: how to fetch the next page

title: List my tickets
